metadata.projection_basis: Arithmetic mean of observed 2023-2025 grid GWh used as alternative base level; same 2025-to-FY2027/28 sector multiplier as central. Not separately projected historical years.
metadata.fixed_inputs: 2025 GB fraction; APS 2024/ABS national shares; BICS class allocation; geographical matrices; support totals; coverage gaps. EII industry shares are recalculated under the same capped-proportional rule.
metadata.limitations: Recent consumption baseline comparison, not a price-response, recovery forecast, confidence interval or resolved Make UK reconciliation. Commercial share fixed, metal-ore expenditure proxy and known-current-only nuclear/gas held fixed.
